degree_rationale: The garments/sons of First Man wept three times, and a fourth weeping at the end for souls cut off. The firmaments themselves grieve as fourth weeping. Inward affective reception of cosmic loss.
direction_rationale: Continues spiritual-north's inward affective reception — weeping as cosmic-receptive faculty. Reflective and emotional-receptive.
grand_man_function: Spiritual weeping-reception — cosmic mourning over souls lost.
title: How the children/garments of the First Man weep in captivity
